chain.title: Worn Notebook
chain.desc: Craft a Book with one Lapis Lazuli; this is the mod's in-game guide and documents every recipe and mechanic that follows.

chain.title: Novice Spell Book
chain.desc: Craft shapelessly from a Book plus an iron sword, pickaxe, axe, and shovel; lets you build and cast Tier 1 spells using mana.

chain.title: Scribe's Table
chain.desc: Craft from 2 Archwood Logs, 3 Archwood Slabs, and 2 Gold Nuggets; combine it with experience and the listed items to learn new glyphs for your book.

chain.title: Imbuement Chamber
chain.desc: Craft from 6 Archwood Planks and 2 Gold Ingots; it slowly infuses items placed inside with Source to transmute them.

chain.title: Source Gem
chain.desc: Place an Amethyst Shard or Lapis Lazuli in the Imbuement Chamber (500 Source each); the core crafting gem for nearly all Ars devices.

chain.title: Source Jar
chain.desc: Craft from 6 Archwood Slabs and 2 Glass; stores the Source that the Imbuement Chamber and Enchanting Apparatus draw from.

chain.title: Agronomic Sourcelink
chain.desc: Craft from 2 Source Gems, 2 Gold Ingots, and Wheat; generates Source from crops growing nearby and pipes it into adjacent Source Jars.

chain.title: Arcane Pedestal
chain.desc: Craft from 4 Sourcestone, 4 Gold Nuggets, and a Source Gem; up to eight of these hold the ingredients for apparatus crafting.

chain.title: Arcane Core
chain.desc: Craft from 6 Sourcestone, 2 Gold Ingots, and a Source Gem; sits directly under the Enchanting Apparatus to complete the multiblock.

chain.title: Enchanting Apparatus
chain.desc: Craft from 2 Sourcestone, 4 Gold Nuggets, 2 Gold Ingots, and a Diamond; placed on an Arcane Core with pedestals around it, it crafts the mod's advanced gear.

chain.title: Magebloom Seed
chain.desc: Your first apparatus craft: any seed as the reagent with 4 Source Gems on pedestals; grow it into Magebloom flowers.

chain.title: Magebloom Fiber
chain.desc: Craft a harvested Magebloom flower into fiber; the textile every piece of mage armor is made from.

chain.title: Sorceror's Wrap
chain.desc: Apparatus craft: a Golden Chestplate surrounded by 4 Magebloom Fiber; mage armor self-repairs from your mana pool and boosts mana regen (Arcanist and Battlemage sets use iron and diamond armor).

chain.title: Dominion Wand
chain.desc: Apparatus craft: a Stick with 2 Source Gems and a Gold Ingot on pedestals; binds summons like Starbuncles to the inventories they should serve.

chain.title: Starbuncle Charm
chain.desc: Hand a wild Starbuncle a Gold Nugget to receive its Token, then apparatus-craft the token with 4 Gold Ingots; the summoned Starbuncle moves items between inventories.

chain.title: Apprentice Spell Book
chain.desc: Upgrade the Novice book at the Enchanting Apparatus with Obsidian, 3 Diamonds, 2 Quartz Blocks, and 2 Blaze Rods; unlocks Tier 2 glyphs and more spell slots.

chain.title: Ritual Brazier
chain.desc: Craft shapelessly from an Arcane Pedestal, a Source Gem Block, and 3 Gold Ingots; place ritual tablets in it to perform the mod's rituals.

chain.title: Ritual of Summon Wilden
chain.desc: Craft the tablet from a Purple Archwood Log, 3 Wilden drops (horn, spike, or wing), and a Lapis Block; run it in the brazier augmented with a Wilden Spike, Horn, and Wing to call the Chimera.

chain.title: Wilden Chimera
chain.desc: Defeat the boss summoned by the augmented Summon Wilden ritual; it resists cold damage and warrants Tier 2 spells and mage armor.

chain.title: Wilden Tribute
chain.desc: Dropped by the Wilden Chimera; the gating ingredient for the final spell book upgrade.

chain.title: Archmage Spell Book
chain.desc: Upgrade the Apprentice book at the apparatus with a Nether Star, Wilden Tribute, 2 Emeralds, 3 Ender Pearls, and a Totem of Undying; unlocks Tier 3 glyphs.

chain.title: Alteration Table
chain.desc: Craft from a Scribe's Table and 4 Magebloom Fiber; inscribes Threads (perks) onto your mage armor's thread slots.

chain.title: Ritual of Flight
chain.desc: Craft the tablet from a Purple Archwood Log, 3 Wilden Wings, 2 Diamonds, and an Ender Pearl; the running ritual grants nearby players renewable creative flight, paid for in Source.

notes: All item ids set-checked against models/item stems intersected with item./block. lang keys (327 ids). Descriptions derived from data/ars_nouveau/recipes/*.json and the bundled Worn Notebook Patchouli book. wilden_boss entity verified in en_us.json (entity.ars_nouveau.wilden_boss = Wilden Chimera). This 1.20.1 version (4.12.x) uses the newer armor system: Sorceror/Arcanist/Battlemage sets replace the old Novice/Apprentice/Archmage robes, tiered up via apparatus upgrade recipes (upgrade_1/upgrade_2). apprentice/archmage books are ars_nouveau:book_upgrade apparatus recipes, not crafting-table recipes. magebloom_crop is the item id of the Magebloom Seed. No ids were dropped.
